## Bottom Sheet Patterns

A bottom sheet is a user-interface pattern used commonly in mobile apps for providing contextual details or controls in the lower area of the screen. Bottom sheets display supplementary content anchored to the bottom of the screen and provide temporarily important information that can be easily accessed and dismissed.

## Thumb Zone & Ergonomics

Bottom tab bars and bottom sheets work well because they sit in the thumb-friendly zone. The "thumb zone" concept shows that users interact with the lower portion of the screen most comfortably, and placing navigation there eliminates friction and fatigue.

## Sticky Add-to-Cart (ATC) Bar Patterns

A sticky Add to Cart bar solves friction by keeping a persistent buy button visible at all times, regardless of scroll position. Merchants who implement sticky ATC report 10–15% conversion rate lifts on product pages, with some mobile-heavy stores seeing improvements up to 20%.

Bottom placement aligns the ATC button with natural thumb reach on smartphones, reducing the motor effort required to tap. Stores that implement sticky ATC typically see 8–15% conversion rate improvements, with higher impact on mobile where scroll depth is greater.

- Auth route naming: `account_.login.ts`, `account_.authorize.ts`, `account_.logout.ts`
- `shouldRevalidate` prevents loader refetch on cart mutations from unrelated routes
- Storefront API proxy always-on (proxyStandardRoutes removed in 2025 release)

**Polaris vs Storefront Tokens (File 5)**
- Polaris CSS vars: `--p-color-bg-surface`, `--p-space-400` (4px base scale), etc.
- Override via `<AppProvider customProperties={{ '--p-color-interactive': '#hex' }}>` — admin only
- Tailwind v4 uses CSS custom properties natively (`--color-primary` maps to `tw-primary`)
- Hard rule: NEVER `import { Button } from '@shopify/polaris'` in storefront; NEVER use `--p-*` vars outside admin

**Subscription UX (File 1)**
- ELI-010 rule: default one-time; default-subscribe only when LTV-sub >3x AND ≥3-step cancel-save AND pause option exists
- Recharge Checkout Extensions = Shopify native checkout (no redirect friction)
- AG1 retention model: starts at order #1, not at churn detection
- Renewal reminder window: 5–7 days before billing date
- Skip → pause → swap → frequency change → cancel = all self-serve, in that order of friction escalation
- Replenishment subscriptions: ~65% subscriber conversion rate (highest tier)
- Skio differentiates on passwordless customer portal login

**Motion & Interaction (File 2)**
- Duration token system: instant=100ms, fast=200ms, base=300ms, slow=500ms
- Spring params for cart drawer (Framer Motion / react-spring): stiffness=300, damping=25
- GSAP ScrollTrigger for complex scroll sequences; CSS scroll-driven animations for simple reveals
- WCAG 2.1 SC 2.3.3 (AAA): motion triggered by interaction must be disableable via `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Optimistic cart: immediate count increment + toast before server confirmation

**Mobile Ecom (File 3)**
- 60–70% ecom traffic is mobile — mobile spec is primary, not afterthought
- Sticky ATC: 8–15% conversion lift (up to 20% mobile), minimum 56px tall, bottom-fixed, z-index above all content
- Bottom sheet filter drawer follows Material Design 3 spec (backdrop + drag handle + snap points)
- Apple Pay / Google Pay = 2 fewer checkout steps vs manual form entry
- Tap targets ≥48px WCAG + Apple HIG + Google HIG (all agree)
- Shop app integration: Shop Pay autofill, Shop app checkout extensions, Shop Pay installments
